name: facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/gossip/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.flatten_tensors: flatten a list of PyTorch tensors into a single contiguous 1D buffer for batch operations
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.unflatten_tensors: unflatten a 1D tensor buffer back into individual tensors using reference tensor shapes
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.communicate_tensors: group tensors by dtype, flatten each group, apply a distributed communication op, and unflatten results
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.create_process_group: create and lazy-initialize a new PyTorch distributed process group for a given list of ranks
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.group_by_dtype: group a list of PyTorch tensors by their data type into a dictionary

facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.create_Meter_instance: create a Meter instance with a custom print tag to track benchmark timing values
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.update_Meter_values: update a Meter with new values and optional count to compute running average and standard deviation
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.reset_Meter_state: reset a Meter to clear all accumulated values including average, sum, count, and standard deviation
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.format_Meter_csv: format a Meter as a CSV string showing current value, average, and standard deviation or MAD
facebookresearch_stochasticgradientpush/.create_stateful_Meter: create a stateful Meter that tracks value history and computes mean absolute deviation over time
